step.cmd: Amend the claimant’s reports processed by referring to Modifying a claimant’s report , if necessary.
Issue payments to the client by referring to Inputting a claimant’s report .
Rescind or terminate the 39 - Prevent payment of Part II benefits and/or incorrect Part I benefits (D39) input by IPOC to cancel potentially fraudulent payments, if necessary.
Determine if there are claimant’s reports to be input for the period before the renewal week:
In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the Integrity registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim corresponding to the claimant’s report to be input.
Work item: Select 92 - Purge and Recreate .
Work type: Select 26 - Processing of a report blocked by a renewal week .
Earnings to be allocated: If necessary, enter the weeks and amounts.
Remarks line 1: Type “Antedate renewal from w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX].”
Remarks lines 2–4: Type “Issue payment for w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX].” Add the claimant’s report details and any allocation information, if necessary.
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Infraction: Select C - Non-fraud - Insurability - new information .
Message: Select 38 - An overpayment resulted due to a change in the start of your claim .
